## ⚠️ SpotyVibe is discontinued — final release

Last.fm is turning its API into a paid service with new licensing terms. Last.fm tag data was the main source behind SpotyVibe's artist database, and MusicBrainz on its own is not enough to keep recommendations at the required quality. **Because of these licensing and paid-service requirements, SpotyVibe will not be developed any further.** This is the last planned release.

### What this means for you

- **Your local install keeps working.** SpotyVibe runs entirely on your machine with your own Spotify and AI-provider keys. Profiles, history, settings, and any artist database or AI-artist blocklist you already downloaded stay on your computer and continue to be used.
- **The hosted artist-database service is shut down.** The cloud service that built and published the artist database and the AI-artist blocklist has been turned off. Fresh installs can no longer download them. Playlist generation still works without the database; **Discover Artists** and the **AI-generated music filter** need a copy that was downloaded before the shutdown.
- **This version no longer contacts the shut-down service.** The update checks for the artist database and the AI blocklist are switched off by default. If you host your own copies, set the `RAG_MANIFEST_URL` / `AI_BLOCKLIST_MANIFEST_URL` environment variables.
- **No further releases, fixes, or support.** The source code stays available.
